args:

export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=/work/src/oomwoo_sim_support:/work/src/oomwoo_coverage:/contrib/src:${PYTHONPATH:-}
export ROS_LOG_DIR=/tmp/roslogs ROS_HOME=/tmp/roshome ROS_DOMAIN_ID=95 ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1
